text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We're now halfway through our summer
training camp, and Mejiro Ardan's making
good progress. One day, as we head out
to start our
afternoon session...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Now then, shall we begi—hm?

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you two! Do you have any plans
tonight? We're holding a test of
courage!
You guys should totally come!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
A test of courage? That's where you
explore a scary location, yes?
I've heard
about them,
but I've never actually joined.

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
W-wait a second, be more considerate!
You don't want to pressure
her... Ardan,
we understand if you can't come because
of your health.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Well... I appreciate the concern. I'm
personally feeling well enough to
attend,
but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She must be worried about alarming the
other participants and event planners. But
if she says she's healthy, I don't see why
she shouldn't
join.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh! Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
All right,
but we'll understand if you can't
make it in the end. Or if you
have to leave
halfway through!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We finish our day of training and head to
where the test of courage is
being held.

text_block_list.name: Ghastly Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Boooo!

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Aaaaahhh! Eeeeek!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From the darkness ahead, we can hear the
screams of other people
braving the test
of courage.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't it?
I'm getting chills just thinking
about it. Now then, it's our
turn.

text_block_list.name: Ghastly Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Boo—Ardan?! S-sorry, I didn't scare you,
did I?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Not at all. Thank you for your concern.

text_block_list.name: Ghastly Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Beware... Bewaaare... Beware the bumps in
the road, Ardan. We don't
want you to trip
and fall.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, I'll keep an eye out. And
please do watch out for bug
bites yourself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As we continue on, it's clear the people
playing the monsters and ghosts are going
easy on Ardan for her sake. I wonder if
Ardan is
enjoying herself...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Who knew a test of courage could
be so delightful?
Everyone's having so
much fun. I'm glad we were invited.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Of course I am. After all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
We're just like those two knights in that
play, seeking glory by
hunting down
ghosts.

text_block_list.name: Knight A
text_block_list.text:
My friend, do my eyes deceive me? Is that
not the accursed castle,
said to only
appear at dusk? What a foreboding
atmosphere...

text_block_list.name: Knights
text_block_list.text: A g-g-g-g-ghost?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now that she mentions it... Despite the fact that the play was a comedy, the premise itself is kinda creepy...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No response. I look over to my side and
realize Ardan is gone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Worried that I accidentally left her
behind,
I whip my head around,
but still no sign of
her...
Wah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Hehe... Ehehe! I wasn't expecting you
to scream like that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Phew... My apologies for scaring you. I
simply couldn't help myself—pretending to
be a ghost just looked like so much fun. I
had
to try it for myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh? I'm looking forward to it. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
What a worthwhile experience. Although
it's a shame we didn't find
any real ghosts
or castles.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, it'll take more than hiding around
the corner and loud noises to scare me.
Still,
it was fun waiting to see what you'd
come up with next.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It felt like I was back to being a child
again... I just feel so at ease
when I'm with
you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: No, I'm fi—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Actually... Do you mind if we rest for a
while?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: We have training tomorrow, correct? What... will the regimen look like? We have been out rather late...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh? Understood.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I am. More than you could ever
imagine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad to have someone who
understands me... Understands that
I want
to do as much as I can.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It's so... reassuring. I—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Do you remember when you told
me it's okay to do what I
want sometimes?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I promised you I wouldn't overdo
it, correct? I assure you, I
am fine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All right, but remember, it's okay to do
what you want sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All right, but remember, it's okay to do
what you want sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: You said I could relax more, no?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Then, could I... rest my head on your
shoulders? The sound of the
waves is just
so... soothing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(What a lovely sound...
I could fall asleep
just like this. In fact, I just
might. Trainer
wouldn't mind.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer... you're like a steady tree.
I know
if I ever need to rest, you'll
be there for
me to lean on.)
